preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
Each test case must have N integers where N is between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each integer in the array A must be between 0 and 10^9.
The total number of integers across all test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any((B[i:j] != C[i:j]) for i in range(1, N) for j in range(i, N+1)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutations B and C exist, output 'NO'.
If valid permutations exist, output 'YES' followed by the permutations B and C.

postconditions.expression: all(B[i:j] != C[i:j] for i in range(1, N) for j in range(i, N+1))
postconditions.description: The permutations B and C must not have any subarrays that are permutations of each other.
